about.title: Engineering Scalable Systems with Precision & Empathy
about.summary: I bridge the gap between rigorous systems engineering and delightful user experiences.
paragraphs: Hello! I am Sharon Sofiya, a senior full-stack engineer and cloud architect with over seven years of hands-on experience designing, shipping, and scaling web systems. My expertise spans reactive frontend interfaces, high-throughput REST and GraphQL APIs, distributed database architectures, and containerized cloud deployments.

Throughout my career at high-growth startups and tech enterprises, I have led engineering teams in decomposing monoliths into event-driven microservices, slashed cloud operational costs by 40%, and crafted accessible, design-system-driven web applications loved by millions.
When I am not coding, I contribute to open-source developer tooling, mentor aspiring developers in coding bootcamps, and write deep-dive architectural analyses on distributed systems.
keyHighlights: Modern Frontends with Bootstrap 5 & Component Architectures
Cloud Infrastructure Automation (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, GCP)

experience.description: Spearheading engineering efforts on multi-tenant SaaS cloud observability and automated deployment tooling.
responsibilities: Architected distributed REST and gRPC API layer processing over 45M telemetry events daily with 99.99% uptime.
Led a squad of 8 engineers across frontend (Bootstrap 5/React) and backend (Node.js/Go) microservices.
Refactored monolithic legacy billing services into an event-driven system with Stripe integration.
Standardized OpenAPI 3.0 documentation company-wide, cutting API client onboarding time by 60%.
achievements: Achieved 35% latency reduction across core API endpoints through Redis intelligent caching.
Awarded Engineering Innovator of the Year 2024.

experience.description: Developed mission-critical financial analytics APIs and real-time dashboard visualization platforms.
responsibilities: Designed and maintained 30+ production REST endpoints with automated Swagger UI documentation.
Built resilient background worker pipelines processing transactional datasets using Redis queues.
Collaborated with UI designers to build responsive enterprise dashboards using Bootstrap and vanilla JS.
Implemented role-based access control (RBAC), JWT token rotation, and rate-limiting middleware.
achievements: Scaled platform to handle 10x query volume during peak quarterly reporting windows.
Zero security vulnerabilities reported in two consecutive SOC 2 Type II external audits.

experience.description: Delivered responsive web portals, progressive web apps, and custom CMS backends for global clients.
responsibilities: Created dynamic, mobile-first responsive interfaces using Bootstrap, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
Integrated third-party payment gateways, CRM tools, and social authentication APIs.
Wrote comprehensive unit and end-to-end test suites ensuring high code quality.
Optimized web vital scores, delivering sub-second load times and 100/100 Lighthouse performance.
achievements: Delivered 18 client web applications on schedule and within budget.
Boosted client conversion rates by an average of 24% via mobile UX redesigns.
